claims.quote: Betta burdigala is a small bubble-nesting labyrinth fish endemic to the island of Bangka, off the east coast of Sumatra, Indonesia.

Endemic to the island of Bangka just off the east coast of Sumatra, Bangka-Belitung province, Indonesia with type locality '4 kilometers north of Bikang village on road from Koba to Toboali, Bangka, Indonesia'.
